question: Why the original's line fill stops two Czech divisions on 2 January.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::ScoreOpsAreaProvinces
addresses.comment:
**RENAMES the inferred `CAIUnit::ApportionOpsArea`** - it apportions nothing; 0x4C8EE0 does that from what this leaves behind. 0x4BD270 to the `ret 4` at 0x4BDCB5, 2632 bytes, read end to end; 8 int3 then a fresh SEH prologue at 0x4BDCC0, one `ret` in the body, no branch target past it, so trap 3 does not apply. Four callers: CAIUnit::SetArea (0x4BB9A7), CAIUnit::SetOpsAreaAndReplan (0x4C05E8), **CAIUnit::SetPlanStance (0x4C3844)** and CAIUnit::ReplanSubtree (0x4DCAA8) - SetPlanStance calls only this of the five, because the score depends on CUnit +0x208.

It computes one float priority per province of the agent's ops area (+0x90), writes it into a fresh 0x1C record {province, 0.0f, score, 0, 0, 0, 0}, inserts the record score-descending into the CList at +0x2C0 (0x4DD4B0), indexes it by province in the ordered map at +0x2D0 (0x4DCF30), and sums every score into +0x34C. 0x4C8EE0 then divides a count among the provinces in proportion to `record->+8 / agent->+0x34C` by largest remainder, capped at `record->+0x18` - that is the apportionment, and it is not here.

The score, per province p: base 10.0. With `agent->+0x364` (frontier at war) clear it is `10*fortLevel + 10`, +10 when some neighbour belongs to a front-worthy enemy, and +20 for exactly `m mod n` of the n provinces by a carried-fraction spread (m = the +0x12C vector's count). With +0x364 set and plan stance < 3 it is `10*passableNeighbours - 10` when the owner area holds more than 5 provinces, plus `2*fortLevel + 20` unless the province has at most one passable neighbour and at least three front neighbours, plus 100 when the province is its own supply depot (+0x48 == +0xD0). With stance >= 3 it is 15.0 for a depot and doubles once per member of `agent->+0x1BC` the province is adjacent to. Then, for a theatre-level agent only, x3 when the province's CAreaBorder front is shorter than a fifth of the ops area; + `defend_prov` priority / 2 (peace) or / 8 (war) for an AI-run country; +100 per region (CProvince +0x358) whose byte +0x6D is set; x the thousandths multiplier from the CCountry +0xCC ratio; and 0 outright when the frontier is at war but this province has no war-candidate or objective-area neighbour.

fortLevel is `p->modifiers (+0x114)[0x50] / 1000`, modifier id 10 FORT_LEVEL. The CCountry +0xCC ratio averages that field over the distinct controller tags of this province's war-candidate / objective-area / front-worthy-enemy neighbours (an _alloca array, 8-byte stride, count at [ebp-0x14]) and compares mean*1000/ours against 150, scaling the score by max(r*1000/150, 50)/1000 when it is at or below - so 0.150 and 0.050 of a ratio, and +0xCC is the country's total brigade combat value.

Note `xor ebx,ebx` at 0x4BD50B destroys the agent pointer; it is reloaded from [ebp+8] at 0x4BD73F, 0x4BD8BF and 0x4BDA41. **The +20's spread, read on the listing 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 69): fraction = (float)((double)(float)(m mod n) / (double)(float)n) at 0x4BD2B4-0x4BD2E8; per province carry = (float)((double)carry + fraction), and where carry >= 1.0f, carry = (float)((double)carry - 1.0) and +20.0 (0x4BDAA5-0x4BDB33). Single precision: 25 of 35 give 25, where thousandths give 24. +0x34C read live as the plain sum of the scores (Praha 2090, Warszawa 975, Wien 560).

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillLinePositions(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* positionMap, int lineCount, int* alliedSoilBudget)
addresses.comment: **The line: divides the line count among the positions and marches committed divisions (+0x12C) into them.** 0x4C8EE0 to the `ret 0x14` at 0x4CA9BD (0x4CA9C0 abuts with no padding - trap 2). Records are the 0x1C CAIProvinceRecord. (A) small fronts: front provinces (+0xC0) whose area holds <= 3 provinces and fewer than 5 enemy land units, and that a committed division stands or heads in. (B) per position in a friendly-controlled province: have and standing zeroed; a province whose only front neighbour is a small front gets want = -1000 (left out); else cap = CAIUnit_GetPositionCap, want = trunc(lineCount x score / ops_area_score_total +0x34C) capped at cap, the remainders carried (0 where score < 1.0 and the total >= 1.0). (C) CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(+0x12C, divisions only, allies too). (D) Nothing given: every position wants 1, or 2 where its province's units have a CUnit +0xC0 above 0. Else while the carry > 0.1, the position with the least want (+100 where want + 1 would pass cap, first of equals) gets one. Then where want > trunc(3.5 x cap) and the province's supplies (+0x164) are nought or its supply need (+0x24C) is at least five times them, want is cut to that and the excess handed to the other positions up to their own 3.5 x cap. (E) each committed division not in a garrison (+0x2C9) and not airborne (CArmy +0x2FC == 8) while air transports exist: d = CUnit_GetPendingDestinationProvince (0x49B010). **With no d**, d = the province it stands in. **With d held by an enemy** (at war by +0xE28[controller]->+0x20, REB on either side, or an undeclared war covering it): the division is **passed over** when its path (+0x140) has fewer than 2 provinces - an attack on a neighbour is left to run - or when d's area (+0x2B4) is no real area (slot 0) or holds 3 provinces or fewer (+0x2C); otherwise it goes on below. **With d not an enemy's**: where it is not retreating (+0x158), holds ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) and d is not its own depot, MoveUnit(next step, or d when the path has one province, 0, 1, 1, 0) and the pass counts as having moved - and it **goes on below** all the same (0x8C9C62 falls through to 0x8C9C66). Below: it **stays** when d is a position whose want (+0xC) is above nought and whose standing (+0x14) is within its cap (+0x18) - not its have against its want - and, where d is a target-area province (+0x1CC), only while d is beside a hostile-route province (+0x1BC) (0x8C9C66-0x8C9DCF). **Otherwise it moves only where CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, strict, 0) allows it** (0x8C9DD5-0x8C9DFA, refused -> the per-unit continue at 0x8CA2B7), strict being the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) other than 0 - every agent below a theatre - and the battle side not asked, so a division defending a battle is not held by the battle; then it goes to the position (have < cap) best by have/want x 100 (+ the excess over 1 again), at war x the distance and (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 where a land battle is on, x 0.66 at a depot, x 0.66 beside a hostile-route province, less 50 x the unit's defensive terrain modifier there (slot 89, GetUnitTerrainModifier(province, unit, false)), that it can reach (CMapProvince::CanUnitReach); failing one, to a second-ring province (+0xA0) picked by a MT19937 seeded with the unit's id. (F) each position still short pulls the division best by squared map distance x 16 + dig-in/100 + attack delay/1000 - 100 x its terrain modifier here (x 0.25 where its own position wants none, else + 100 x its terrain modifier where it is bound), able to reach and leave. **The pull's candidates** (0x8CA387-0x8CA4F3): not retreating, not a garrison, standing somewhere; d = 0x89AF00 (a destination, not read) or where it stands; where d is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), not one 0x8AF4E0 answers true for (not read); with the allied-soil budget spent, not one CAIUnit_IsMoveFromHomeAreaToAlliedSoil (0x4C77C0) refuses; not airborne while air transports exist; not one holding ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) whose own province is a position that wants divisions - the map looked up through 0x8DCF30 is the function's third argument, positionMap, keyed by the unit's province (+0x130), and the test is the record's want (+0xC) above 0; and **not one whose d is held by a country it is at war with (CCountry::IsEnemy, 0x42F210) and lies beside the province it stands in, by any edge** - an attack under way. **The pull's fuller test** (0x8CA2C7-0x8CA74A): for the short position T, notDepot = 0 where T's province is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), else 1, and T fill = (T.have + notDepot) / T.want in single precision. For each candidate, D = the position record of its d (null where d is no position); count = D.standing (+0x14) where the unit stands at d, else D.have (+0x10); the candidate is **taken without the test** where D is null, D.want <= 0, or (it does not stand at d, T.standing < 1 and it stands at T). Otherwise k = 0 where notDepot is 0, else 1 where T.have != 0 or count <= 1, else 0; and it is **passed over unless (count - k) / D.want > T fill**. Past that, where the agent +0x364 is set, the plan's stance (+0x64 -> +0x208) is below 2 and count <= D.want, it is passed over unless T is its own province's neighbour or a neighbour's neighbour - the edges of the province it stands in (+0xD4 -> +0x90, 0x14 a record), kind 3 skipped, each neighbour needing its +0x22 and +0x13D bytes set. The score is then x 0.25 where D.want < 1 - **D null included** - else + 100 x the unit's terrain modifier at d. **The best is kept by strict < and must pass CanUnitReach(T, unit, 1, 1) and CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) != 0, 0)**; once chosen: D.have - 1 and D.standing - 1 where D's province is where it stands (0x8CA8F1-0x8CA91D), 0x8C78E0(agent, T, unit, alliedSoilBudget) (not read), MoveUnit(unit, T, 0, 1, 1, 0), T.have + 1 and T.standing + 1 where T is where it stands, and the pull repeats while T.have < T.want. None left -> CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition. Every move is CEU3AI::MoveUnit(unit, province, 0, safe, very safe). See FINDINGS-moving.md, sections A.4, A.4b and A.4e. **On the listing, 2026-11-10: the carry leaves out a position scoring under 1.0 where the scores come to 1.0 or more, as the share does** (0x8C9480). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 16. **Both halves read on the listing, 2026-11-10.** The send walks the positions with a want and under their cap in list order: one where the division stands is taken at once, unless the division is bound for a target province away from the hostile routes, when only positions beside one are looked at. The key: have/want x 100, plus (have/want - 1) x 100 above 1; at war instead the distance **from where it is bound** x (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 for a land battle there; then less 50 x the terrain figure; then x 0.66 at a depot and x 0.66 beside a hostile route, all in single precision, from 1000000.0. The chosen is counted (the old record -1, standing too where it stood there; the new +1) and sent whatever MoveUnit answers. The pull's fill of the short position is worked out **once**, before its loop, and does not move as divisions are pulled to it; a candidate bound for its own depot under a blocking order (UnitHasBlockingOrder) is passed over. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 17. **Read live 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 60): the position list is the second argument ([ebp+0xC]), a chain of nodes holding the record at +0 and the next node at +8; at the pull's MoveUnit call (0x4CA945) the unit is in EDI, the target province in ESI, the target's record at [ebp-0x50]. The send's reach test, like the pull's, is CanUnitReach's land answer, the areas joined: Cdo. Sup. Africa's send left empty positions in Somalia to divisions in Eritrea and filled 9734 four deep instead. **Step (D) seen on the running game 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 69): Praha HQ, line 23 over 35 positions whose scores sum to 2090 against a best of 90, gave no position a share, so every one wanted 1; the two divisions standing on positions were then moved to their own provinces (caller 0x4CA94A), stopping them.
